    //==
    // # IVectorField2D
    //
    // A planar vector field. Evaluation itself is the generic ValueAt; the helpers
    // here project the sampled vector to scalar and direction summaries.

    // The length of the sampled vector: flow speed or displacement magnitude.
    MagnitudeAt(self: IVectorField2D, point: Point2D): Number
        => self.Eval(point).Magnitude;
